prompt: 53 yo F with history of rheumatoid arthritis (on methotrexate, weekly folate, and chronic low-dose prednisone) presents with new cough, malaise, and bilateral ground-glass opacities on CT chest; O2 sat 95% on room air, afebrile, normal WBC. Presumed Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia (PJP); you consider first-line tx: initiate TMP-SMX at standard dosing (15-20 mg/kg/day of TMP component), continue home low-dose methotrexate during treatment?

rubric_items.text: Recognizes the dangerous methotrexate–TMP-SMX interaction and recommends withholding methotrexate throughout TMP-SMX treatment because of severe myelosuppression/pancytopenia risk, noting that folic acid supplementation does not make coadministration safe.
Recommends obtaining baseline CBC, renal function, and potassium and monitoring these during high-dose TMP-SMX therapy for hematologic, renal, and electrolyte toxicity.
